continuity: Jin is poisoned by the Manticore Lord; his Fire Dragon Armor is damaged and at risk of being automatically returned to his Inventory if damaged again.
Jin’s special debuff has drastically reduced all his stats, but his strength still lets him overpower the Lycanthrope Champion.
Jin kills the Manticore Lord with a dagger and hellfire; an unidentified ally kills the Lycanthrope Champion before Jin can finish it.
The Skeleton King is fighting the Death Knight Legion Commander.
plot: Jin fights the Manticore Lord and Lycanthrope Champion while the Skeleton King battles the Death Knight Legion Commander. After the Manticore Lord damages his Fire Dragon Armor and poisons him, Jin uses the Lycanthrope Champion’s claw to hold it in place, then kills the Manticore Lord with a dagger and hellfire. Just as Jin is about to finish the Lycanthrope Champion, an unidentified ally arrives and cuts off its head.
translation_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Render the source’s 만티코아 로드 as Manticore Lord, consistent with the established Manticore terminology.
Preserve “Jin Sama” as the arriving ally’s form of address; the speaker is unidentified in this chapter.

active_continuity: Jin is the World Hunter Federation’s Alliance Leader and pursues Main Quest [Cataclysm], which requires him to eliminate The Prophet within an unspecified time limit.
Jin commands roughly one thousand Hunters against a monster force exceeding ten thousand in the Rub’ al Khali.
The monster army obeys an unseen authority; The Prophet’s location remains unknown.
The Manticore Lord and Lycanthrope Champion are dead; an unidentified ally delivered the Lycanthrope Champion’s final blow.
Jin is poisoned, his Fire Dragon Armor is damaged, and his special debuff has drastically reduced his stats.
The Skeleton King is fighting the Death Knight Legion Commander.
The battle against the monster army is ongoing. The Manticore Lord was especially strong and cunning.
open_questions: Where is The Prophet, and how is he directing the monster army?
Can the defenders hold against the monster force, including its aerial monsters?
Can Jin survive the poison and repair or protect his damaged Fire Dragon Armor?
How will the fight between the Skeleton King and Death Knight Legion Commander end?
temporary_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Use Manticore Lord for the source spelling 만티코아 로드.

names.notes: S-rank monster commander; source spelling variant of Manticore.
Monster commander fighting the Skeleton King.
